d18.why: Underline the 4 (thousands place). Next door is 3. 4 or less means stay, and the rest become 0: 64,000.

d19.why: Underline the 8 (thousands place). Next door is 5. 5 or more means round up: 8 becomes 9, so 29,000.

d20.why: Underline the 2 (tenths place). Next door is 3, so it stays. Digits after it drop off: 4.2.
